skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the differences between domestic and international business, and the impact of national and international environment on international business activities.
Analyze the impact of cultural differences on international business activities.
Analyze the impact of political and legal differences between countries on international business activities.
Analyze the impact of economic factors on international business activities.
Understand trends in international trade and investment, and government intervention in international trade and investment.
Understand the concept, objectives, and levels of global and regional economic integration.
Understand the role of international financial markets in international business activities.
Apply knowledge and skills to solve problems arising in international business activities.
Propose solutions for specific situations in international business.
